'''Umate''' was one of the highest peaks of the [[Manarai Mountains]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and was the only outcropping of natural stone on the planet's surface. It was protected by the monks of the [[Flames of Umate]] cult, who patrolled the peak and prevented tourists from chipping off souvenirs from the stone. It was surrounded by [[Monument Plaza/Legends|Monument Plaza]]. The monks meditated while touching the rock in an effort to contact Coruscant's "inner spirit".<ref name="CatCW" />
